benches.name: decode_exact
benches.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/qfd_kvc_decode_pc_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/qfd_kvc_decode_pc_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012 -s tb_qwen_kvc_decode_pc -P tb_qwen_kvc_decode_pc.NEG=0 -o {RUN}/bench/dec0 rtl/test/tb_qwen_kvc_decode_pc.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_kvc_decode_pc.sv && vvp -n {RUN}/bench/dec0
}
benches.note: [m5rr: run on the d85c4b6ce snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/qfd_kvc_decode_pc_m5/src]
